description: Tiny Comet Studio is a small indie team from Pakistan, led by Haroon Sheikh, making colourful, friendly games and apps for mobile and PC.

hero.eyebrow: Indie games & apps · Made in Pakistan
hero.lead: We're Tiny Comet — a small, independent team crafting cozy, colourful games and thoughtfully built apps for phones and PCs. Easy to pick up, kind to your time, and a little bit magical.

about.title: A small team with a big soft spot for play
about.lead: Tiny Comet Studio is an independent team based in Pakistan, founded by Haroon Sheikh.
paragraphs: We started Tiny Comet because we love the feeling of a great little game or a genuinely useful app — the kind you open on the bus, smile at, and come back to tomorrow. We're small on purpose: it keeps us close to every detail, and close to the people who play what we make.
Everything we build is designed, coded and polished in-house, and we share the journey as we go. If you like what you see, come say hi — we read every message.

expertise.title: Mobile apps
expertise.text: Native-feeling apps for iOS and Android, designed for real everyday use.

expertise.title: Games
expertise.text: Bite-sized, joyful games for mobile and PC with plenty of charm.

expertise.title: Cross-platform
expertise.text: One codebase, many screens — phones, tablets, desktop and the web.

expertise.title: UI / UX design
expertise.text: Friendly, clear interfaces that feel good the moment you tap them.

expertise.title: Publishing & updates
expertise.text: App Store and Google Play releases, plus ongoing updates after launch.

press.boilerplate: Tiny Comet Studio is a small independent games and apps studio from Pakistan, founded by Haroon Sheikh. The team designs, builds and publishes colourful, friendly games and apps for mobile, PC and the web.
